title: 第13章 狂刀樊彪第14章 一象之力
content_zh:
武会！
这里的布置跟蓝星的地下擂台相差不大，只是规模要大不少，光是擂台就足足有两个篮球场大。
毕竟是供修炼者对垒的平台，如果太小，根本施展不开。
擂台周边则是无数的座位，那些都是普通观看者的区域。
另外在普通观看区的上方，还会有一些特制的雅间，专供王公贵族，有实力的修炼者观看。
能进入那些包间的，都是非富即贵的主，不缺修炼资源，来此只为得一乐，想看人殊死搏杀。
江若尘跟着侍女路过时，特意观察了一下现场以及雅间，发现今夜大多数雅间的灯笼都是亮着，说明其中有客。
其中的七号雅间，江若尘格外留意了一下。
因为他有直觉，在那外不见里，里可见外的特制屏风后面，有好几双讥讽的眼睛正在盯着他。
扫视两眼，江若尘也没说什么，转头跟侍女离开武会区域，进入等待上场的后台……
“这个废物真是找死，越级挑战就算了，竟然还敢挑战四重天！”
七号雅间屏风后，六公主眼神狠毒地盯着江若尘离去的背影。
江立也是一脸阴狠：“六姐，你放心吧，我已经跟后台打好招呼了，只要这废物今天敢上台，就让他下不了擂台！”
“那就好。”
六公主微笑起来，他们都是恨不得江若尘这个废物死去，免得日后给他们蒙羞……
后台，才步入这里的江若尘立刻就感受到了浓郁的血腥，蛮横的气息。
江若尘扫视了一下，发现整个后台的人个个都是面露凶狠，一看就不是善茬，都是刀口舔血修行上来的那种人。
那血腥，蛮横的气息也正是从那些人身上散发出来的。
而此时那些人恰好也注意到了他，都投来了审视的目光，想将江若尘底细看穿。
好在江若尘已经让老龙用葬神塔屏蔽了他所有的气息，导致旁人根本无法看出他的半点底细来。

“先生，这就是后台区域了，这有很多的兵器，器材供您热身，等您上场时会有专人来跟您接洽。”
侍女此时对江若尘道。
“好。”
江若尘收回目光点点头，而后不再去关注其他人，径直地走向一能观看到整个武会擂台的区域盘坐了下来。
比起热身，他更想好好的观摩一下武会接下来的战斗。
他有对战四重天的实力，可极度缺乏战斗经验，这在武会擂台上来说是很致命的弱点。
哪个混迹武会的人不是身经百战，刀口舔血？
论境界，混迹这里的人绝对不能说高，可要论杀人技，实战经验，在整个王城，这里的人绝对排得上号。
虽说现在观摩，有点临时抱佛脚的味道，可这也是没办法的办法，临时观摩一些总比一窍不通好。
“小家伙，看来你对自己充满了信心，才有一象一牛之力，就敢挑战经验丰富的四重天修炼者。”
江若尘才坐下，老龙的声音忽然在耳边响起。
“没办法，为了资源不得不博，况且不经历战斗，又何来成长！”
江若尘平静道。
“欢迎各位贵客光临今日的武会，今天的第一场，将是通脉九重天的对决！”
老龙声音没有再响起，而台下随着一妖娆性感的主持人上场，性感中带着磁性的声音响起，这场武会也正式开始。
第一场便是九重天的对决，通脉九重天距离气海不过半步之遥，这种级别的对战引得所有人的瞩目。
江若尘也是目不转睛的关注了起来。
content_en:
Martial arts meeting!
The layout here is not much different from Blue Star's underground arena, but the scale is much larger. The arena alone is as big as two basketball courts.
After all, it is a platform for practitioners to compete. If it is too small, it will not be able to be used.
There are countless seats around the ring, which are areas for ordinary spectators.
In addition, above the general viewing area, there will be some specially designed private rooms for princes, nobles and powerful practitioners to watch.
Those who can enter those private rooms are all rich or noble, and they have no shortage of cultivation resources. They come here just for fun and want to watch people fight to the death.
When Jiang Ruochen passed by with the maid, he carefully observed the scene and the private rooms, and found that the lanterns in most of the private rooms were on tonight, indicating that there were guests.
Among them, Jiang Ruochen paid special attention to Room No. 7.
Because he had an intuition that there were several pairs of sarcastic eyes staring at him behind the special screen that could not see the outside but the inside.
After glancing around, Jiang Ruochen didn't say anything, turned around and left the martial arts meeting area with the maid, and entered the backstage waiting for the show...
"This loser is really looking for death. Even if he skips the challenge, he still dares to challenge the fourth heaven!"
Behind the screen in private room No. 7, the Sixth Princess stared at Jiang Ruochen's leaving back with vicious eyes.
Jiang Li also had a sinister look on his face: "Sixth sister, don't worry, I have already said hello to the backstage. As long as this loser dares to come on stage today, he will not be able to get off the stage!"
"That's good."
The Sixth Princess smiled. They all wished Jiang Ruochen, a loser, would die so as not to bring shame to them in the future...
Backstage, Jiang Ruochen, who had just stepped into this place, immediately felt the rich blood and brutal aura.
Jiang Ruochen glanced around and found that everyone in the backstage looked fierce. At first glance, they were not good-natured people. They were all the kind of people who had cultivated themselves by licking blood from the edge of a knife.
The bloody and barbaric aura emanated from those people.
At this time, those people happened to notice him, and they all cast a scrutinizing gaze, trying to see through Jiang Ruochen's true identity.
Fortunately, Jiang Ruochen had asked Old Long to use the God Burial Tower to block all his aura, so that others could not see any of his details.
"Sir, this is the backstage area. There are many weapons and equipment for you to warm up. Someone will come to contact you when you come on stage."
The maid said to Jiang Ruochen at this time.
"Okay."
Jiang Ruochen withdrew his gaze and nodded, then stopped paying attention to the others and walked straight to an area where he could see the entire martial arts arena and sat down cross-legged.
Rather than warming up, he wanted to observe the upcoming battle of the martial arts association.
He has the strength to fight against the fourth heaven, but he extremely lacks combat experience, which is a fatal weakness in the martial arts arena.
Which person who joins the martial arts association has not experienced hundreds of battles and licked blood from his sword?
In terms of realm, the people who hang out here cannot be said to be high, but in terms of killing skills and actual combat experience, the people here are definitely ranked high in the entire royal city.
Although observing now feels a bit like improvising, there is no other way. It is better to observe something temporarily than to know nothing at all.
"Little guy, it seems that you are full of confidence in yourself. Only with the power of an elephant and an ox, you dare to challenge the experienced practitioners of the fourth heaven."
Just as Jiang Ruochen sat down, Old Long's voice suddenly sounded in his ears.
"I have no choice. I have to gamble for resources. Besides, if you don't experience battles, how can you grow!"
Jiang Ruochen said calmly.
"Welcome all distinguished guests to today's martial arts meeting. The first match today will be the Tongmai Nine Heavens showdown!"
Lao Long's voice stopped, and as a voluptuous and sexy host came on stage, the sexy and magnetic voice sounded, and the martial arts competition officially began.
The first battle was the battle between Jiuchongtian and Tongmai Jiuchongtian, which was only half a step away from the Qi Sea. This level of battle attracted everyone's attention.
Jiang Ruochen also couldn't take his eyes away.started to pay attention.
